notes: Setup → Screen layout: clicking a widget shows how it appears (height, show, when to show, remove) on the left and its own settings on the right, saved together – no page picker (drag it instead)
A widget shown in place of another at other times opens straight to its own settings
Each copy of a widget has its own settings. A new copy starts with the first one’s settings; removing a spare copy drops its settings; removing the last one keeps them for next time

Child points widgets, rearranged for at-a-glance: name, reminders, points with the Cash in button beside them, three next tasks, this morning – then the progress bar and penalty buttons at the bottom. Drag up and down to scroll if there’s more

The screen gets itself going again: if the Sheet hasn’t answered for 10 minutes and nobody is using it, it reloads itself (then after 20, 40 and every 60 minutes if still stuck) – only when it can load its own page, so it never ends up on a “no internet” page
